title: Stop exhausting yourself before prayer
summary: Exhaustion becomes prayer when self-rescue finally runs out. Return the breath before fear chooses the story.
takeaway: Return the breath before fear chooses the story.
lifeApplication: Before the next defensive move, bring the breath back under one line of refuge and mercy.

source.shortMeaning: Exhaustion becomes prayer when self-rescue finally runs out.
source.lifeApplication: When you are spent, ask for help before starting another rescue attempt.

evidence.coreClaim: Exhaustion becomes prayer when self-rescue finally runs out.
evidence.turn: Keep this in front of you: call for shelter before fear becomes your only voice.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before the next defensive move, bring the breath back under one line of refuge and mercy.
